# Participant Role

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ParticipantRole`](gmeow-ParticipantRole.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ParticipantRole>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The role an entity plays in an event — a VALUE, never a participation subproperty. The set is open; a role not among the seeds is a FRESH [`gmeow:ParticipantRole`](gmeow-ParticipantRole.md) individual with [rdfs:label.](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label.) Carried by [`gmeow:participationRole`](../properties/gmeow-participationRole.md) on a [`gmeow:Participation`](gmeow-Participation.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ParticipantRole`](gmeow-ParticipantRole.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the participation-role axis — the open set of individuals (principal, witness, officiant, performer, …) that [`gmeow:participationRole`](../properties/gmeow-participationRole.md) draws from; mint a fresh individual for a role not seeded.

### Avoid when

- Avoid reviving a hasWitness-style participation SUBPROPERTY (the former genealogy idiom was refactored into role values, [Principle 6](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-6)), and avoid confusing it with [`gmeow:EventType`](gmeow-EventType.md) — role is who-did-what, type is what-kind, two orthogonal axes.

### How to use

- Add a new role as a [`gmeow:ParticipantRole`](gmeow-ParticipantRole.md) individual with [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) and [skos:definition](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition); reference it from a [`gmeow:Participation`](gmeow-Participation.md) via [`gmeow:participationRole`](../properties/gmeow-participationRole.md), which is non-functional so a participant may bear several roles.

### Examples

- ex:roleBestMan a [`gmeow:ParticipantRole`](gmeow-ParticipantRole.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "best man"@en.
